metadata.description: Agent Skills for the EVtivity CSMS: set up, configure, deploy, operate, test, integrate, troubleshoot and report issues

plugins.name: evtivity-getting-started
plugins.description: Stand up a local EVtivity stack end to end with Docker, check health and sign in. Intro, quick start, installation and project structure.

plugins.name: evtivity-configuration
plugins.description: Configure EVtivity: environment variables, authentication, API keys, roles, MFA, reCAPTCHA, database setup and OCPP server settings.

plugins.name: evtivity-deployment
plugins.description: Deploy EVtivity: Docker images, Docker Compose, Helm chart on Kubernetes, AWS CDK, minikube, upgrades and production checks.

plugins.name: evtivity-csms
plugins.description: Operate the EVtivity dashboard: sites, stations, sessions, drivers, tokens, fleets, pricing, reservations, smart charging, roaming, reports, users and settings.

plugins.name: evtivity-portal
plugins.description: Use and support the EVtivity driver portal: registration, charging, guest charging, payment methods, RFID cards, sessions, vehicles and support.

plugins.name: evtivity-mobile-app
plugins.description: Set up, white-label, build and release the EVtivity driver app, and support drivers using it.

plugins.name: evtivity-integrations
plugins.description: Set up payments and integrations: Stripe, Stripe Connect payouts, Adyen, the test payment provider, webhooks and energy management.

plugins.name: evtivity-simulator
plugins.description: Drive the EVtivity charging station simulator: modes, simulated OCPP 1.6 and 2.1 stations, actions and full test sessions.

plugins.name: evtivity-conformance
plugins.description: Test OCPP behavior: send commands and read results, message logs, the OCTT conformance runner and published results.

plugins.name: evtivity-guides
plugins.description: Follow the EVtivity how-to guides: station onboarding and lifecycle, sessions, RFID, reservations, smart charging, messages, users, white-labeling and field troubleshooting.

plugins.name: evtivity-api
plugins.description: Use the EVtivity REST API: API keys, permissions, pagination, errors, OCPP commands and curl examples.

plugins.name: evtivity-troubleshoot
plugins.description: Diagnose a broken EVtivity stack: migrations, station connections, reCAPTCHA, Redis, payments, ports and upgrades, with a redacted diagnostics script.

plugins.name: evtivity-report-issue
plugins.description: Draft a redacted issue for the EVtivity maintainers and open it after the user confirms.
